name: Sanritsu Corporation
summary: Sanritsu Corporation engages in the packaging, transportation, and warehousing business in Japan and internationally. The company offers steel, wooden box, reinforced cardboard, and cardboard packing products. It also provides truck transportation services, as well as warehouse storage, and cargo handling services. In addition, it offers bonded and customer clearance services; air and sea transport arrangement services; and rental building business. Sanritsu Corporation was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
